platforms.note: The pages read describe physical manikins, task trainers and a wearable sound vest, none of which fit the allowed labels. 'AR' rests only on the Evo AuRA product name ('Augmented Reality Apparel'); the page describes an RFID vest heard through a Bluetooth stethoscope, not a headset or screen overlay. The about page mentions 'virtual and physical' solutions without naming a virtual platform. Educator-side software is not counted: Evo AuRA scenarios are controlled from a tablet and use the 'Evo AuRA Windows Application' (Windows 11), LearningSpace is center-management software, and Evo has 'cloud-connected software' for fleet management. No VR, web or mobile learner access is described.
